title: Consolidate the two herdr clients the deletion epic left behind
body: The epic exists to end 'extracted means copied', yet its integrated diff ADDS a second herdr wire client: internal/herdclient (commit ed92010e, tick nkf) coexists with the untouched internal/herd/client, and transport.go (141 lines), protocol.go (242), socketpath.go (43) and client.go (285) are byte-identical in both except the package clause and error prefix. Dashboard, herdtest and cmd/tk/cmd/herd_shared.go import the old client; relay, runnersconfig and herd_relay.go import the new; ticfac holds a third copy. Point dashboard (+herd_shared) at internal/herdclient — growing its 99-line methods.go to cover AgentList, SubscribeAgentStatus/EventStream and TerminalStatuses — and delete internal/herd/client along with herdclient/doc.go's false claim that the old package 'moved to ticfac'; or delete internal/herdclient, which keeps the full ~4.4K-line execution surface in-repo against the epic's premise. nkf's GOES list also named herd_shared.go, herdtest and internal/herd/state for deletion; all three survive.
